summary.name: VictorOps (Splunk On-Call)
summary.one_liner: VictorOps, now renamed Splunk On-Call, is an incident management and on-call alerting product for DevOps and operations teams.
use_cases: give stakeholders visibility into critical incidents
manage on-call rotations for devops teams
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Splunk landing page announcing that VictorOps is now Splunk On-Call. It describes the product as a tool that helps developers, DevOps and operations teams manage on-call duties and reduce mean time to acknowledge and restore outages. Teams receive context-rich notifications and collaborate cross-functionally to resolve incidents. Stakeholders can view critical incidents and the steps taken to resolve them. The page itself does not list specific features, pricing or integrations.
notable: Renamed from VictorOps to Splunk On-Call after Splunk's acquisition
Context-rich incident notifications for on-call teams
Stakeholder visibility into incidents and resolution steps
caveats: Page is a rename/acquisition notice with few product details
Pricing and detailed features are not stated on this page
The original VictorOps brand has been replaced by Splunk On-Call
